input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: explore: new venture ranked-ballot-counter (IRV, STV, Schulze ballot counts)
errors: IRV recounted every ballot from scratch, reviving ballots exhausted on an equal ranking; property test (IRV vs 1-seat STV) caught it on random seed 35, fixed.
Format detection read a preference-line file where most voters rank one candidate as CSV; caught by the independent Python recount (2,999/3,000), fixed.
A numbered ID column in a grid export was read as a candidate; caught in the Chromium run, fixed with a metadata-column list.
Post description was 185 chars; check_post_frontmatter.py's last line (the rule summary) hid the actual error when I tailed one line, so the first local build failed on it.
integrity_issues: Could not fetch Wikipedia or the Scottish Order (hosts outside the network allowlist). The 45-voter Schulze profile and result were confirmed via search snippets and its pairwise counts recomputed in Python; the STV food example's Wikipedia version could not be confirmed, so it is described as hand-counted, not as a Wikipedia example; the Scottish rules' 5-decimal truncation could not be confirmed from the statute, so it is stated as this tool's own choice.

doc_friction.issue: On failure it prints the error line then a rule-summary line; `| tail -1` shows only the summary, which looks like success output. Exit code is the reliable signal.

portfolio-pages.yml 'Build the site' step is reported as skip under --for-changes and by name, so the real build + check.mjs had to be run by hand (node build.mjs --out=DIR --audio-cdn; node check.mjs DIR).
Definition of done asks for an inline-SVG chart and data/SOURCE.md; neither fits a ballot counter whose example is a textbook profile (no dataset), so judgement was needed.

deviations.why: No inline-SVG chart and no data/ directory: the result is round tables and a head-to-head matrix, and the example is a four-line textbook profile embedded in the engine with its source cited.
deviations.did: Round tables, a coloured head-to-head table and a plain-language summary instead.
deviations.result: Page reviewed in Chromium at 390 px; no chart needed to read the count.

goal: Ship a new, verifiable free tool nobody in the portfolio covers.
notes: Explore idea: ranked-ballot counter (instant runoff, multi-seat STV with Droop quota + WIGM transfers, Schulze) for clubs/boards/unions/student elections; browser page + CLI + agent engine, filed under Research algorithms & ML. Verification: four-city IRV/Condorcet and Schulze 45-voter examples, hand-counted STV, property tests on 300 random elections in suite (5,000 one-off), independent Python recount (crosscheck/) 1,909/1,909 IRV and 3,000/3,000 Schulze. Local checks: venture tests 36/36; doc-refs, portfolio-validate (pytest steps unrun), control-plane-guard ran; sibling-links fixed by linking from quick-pick-survey; site build exit 0 and check.mjs 'publishable: 1361 products, no dead links'; platform/pages suite 1,646 pass / 1 fail of 1,673: 'an identical build produces an identical cache name' failed in the full run (likely contention with a concurrent build in this container) and passed when rerun alone. STV not checked against another STV program (none offline). No agent doc written: the README and run record carry what a next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: engine with three counting methods and CSV/Forms parsing, 36 tests, independent Python recount, page, guide, CLI, docs: a senior engineer's estimate

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
